JobDef.reportString: Handling accommodation at the hotel reception desk.
Sleeping at the hotel until wake-up time.
Using the hot spring and apparel locker.

SimManagementLib.SimDef.CustomerActionDe.label: hotel check-in
SimManagementLib.SimDef.CustomerActionDe.description: Check in at reception, reserve a rental bed and begin a persistent hotel stay.

SimManagementLib.SimDef.CustomerActionDe.label: hot spring bathing
SimManagementLib.SimDef.CustomerActionDe.description: Reserve a bathing spot and locker, queue at the staffed reception desk to buy a ticket, then store clothing and enter the pool. Actual clothing is returned when bathing ends or is interrupted.

SimManagementLib.SimDef.ShopStaffRoleDef.label: hotel receptionist
SimManagementLib.SimDef.ShopStaffRoleDef.description: Staffs the hotel reception desk, handles check-in, extensions and check-out, and also serves as a cashier. Uses the framework's service work type.
